bullets.text: I learned that **Microsoft** is releasing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26200.5761, which includes a new feature allowing users to seamlessly resume apps from their Android phone on their Windows 11 PC, starting with **Spotify** integration.
I found out that the Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26120.5761 is also rolling out the same cross-device resume feature for **Spotify**, enhancing user experience for those in the Beta Channel.
I discovered that **Microsoft** is introducing a new 'My Apps' feature in the Xbox PC App, allowing **Xbox Insiders** to access games and essential applications more conveniently on Windows 11.
I read about **Microsoft's** efforts to combat the ClickFix social engineering technique, which has been increasingly used to trick users into executing malicious commands on their devices.

I noted that **Microsoft** is advancing its quantum-safe security measures to prepare for the future risks posed by quantum computing, collaborating with various international standards organizations.
I learned that **Microsoft** is rolling out semantic file search capabilities in the Copilot app on Windows, allowing users to find files using natural language queries.
I found that **Microsoft** is releasing Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 27928, which includes various improvements and fixes, such as changes to time and language settings.

I discovered that **Microsoft** Threat Intelligence has been analyzing the PipeMagic malware, a sophisticated modular backdoor used in targeted attacks, highlighting its advanced architecture and evasion tactics.
I noted that **Microsoft** is pushing for the adoption of multi-agent systems in AI, moving away from single-agent architectures to better handle complex enterprise workflows.

I learned that **Microsoft** is actively working on post-quantum cryptography to ensure future security against quantum computing threats, demonstrating a proactive approach to evolving cybersecurity challenges.
